api.intro: MCP keys let AI clients (Claude, Cursor, custom scripts) push raw entries into your corpus, promote them, manage codes. Each key is an Ed25519 keypair — server stores only the public half; you save the private PEM in ~/.standmeet/credentials.json and the client signs per request.
api.empty: no keys yet · generate one to wire up your first AI client

aiProvider.heading: owner's ai
aiProvider.intro: The provider visitors talk to. Pick a preset or point at your own self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint (ollama / vllm / lm-studio). Key is encrypted at rest with INSTANCE_SECRET and never read back to this page.

mcpClient.heading: mcp setup
mcpClient.subhead: save credentials.json + paste config into your client
mcpClient.foot: after pasting + saving credentials.json (mode 0600), restart your client. each request signs a short-lived sigv1 challenge — server never sees your private key.

mcpDownload.heading: connect your mcp client
mcpDownload.intro: Point your AI client at your instance’s MCP endpoint. Auth is the Ed25519 keypair you generate above (Sigv1). The endpoint aggregates your owner tools over MCP-over-HTTP.
mcpDownload.note: Claude Desktop / Cursor connect through the stdio client in the config above (npx @standmeet/mcp-client), which speaks MCP-over-HTTP with Sigv1 to this endpoint under the hood.

mcpServers.heading: External MCP servers
mcpServers.intro: MCP servers the visitor agent can call as tools. Add one you got from anywhere — its URL and an optional auth header — then attach it to a role under codes.
mcpServers.checkTools: {count, plural, =0 {answers, but offers no tools} one {# tool} other {# tools}}
mcpServers.checkRefused: it answered, but rejected the auth header — check the header name and value
mcpServers.checkNoAnswer: no answer — nothing responded at that URL

newlyCreated.warning: save these now — the private key is shown only once

suppliers.intro: 공급자 let the agent reach external services — Calendar and Mail are live below, and you can upload your own (OpenAPI / protocol) supplier to add more.

calendar.heading: Google Calendar
calendar.credentialsHint: Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID (Desktop). Owner's own client; no global StandMeet OAuth.
calendar.timezoneUnsetHint: not set, so the hours above are read as UTC. your browser says {detected} — pick it and visitors get the hours you meant.

blockPanel.heading: 블록
blockPanel.intro: 블록을 끄면 그 도구가 모든 방문자 세션에서 사라집니다. 내장 블록은 비활성화할 수 있지만 삭제할 수는 없습니다. 직접 작성한 것만 제거할 수 있습니다.

supplierOp.unreachable: Couldn’t reach your instance — check your connection and retry.

skills.promptPlaceholder: 기본 페르소나에 덧붙이는 추가 시스템 프롬프트…

marketplaceTab.intro: Skills aggregate from two sources — the open <ink>anthropics/skills</ink> GitHub repo (anyone can fork + PR) and <ink>SkillsMP</ink> (commercial channel). Installing fetches the skill’s SKILL.md, parses its frontmatter, and writes a local copy you fully own — edit the prompt or allowed-tools after, decoupled from the marketplace.
marketplaceTab.manualHint: Found a skill somewhere else? Paste its <ink>SKILL.md</ink> (YAML frontmatter + body). It installs as a local copy you own — no marketplace, no network fetch.
marketplaceTab.empty: No skills match. Try a different term, or switch source — the GitHub repo and SkillsMP are queried in parallel.

mySkills.empty: No skills yet — install one from the marketplace tab, or add your own under Skills.

providerBook.heading: provider book
providerBook.intro: Every provider you can send a turn to. One of them is the default — the one used when neither the access code nor the role names another. Deleting an entry is safe: codes and roles pointing at it fall back to the default.
providerBook.empty: no entries yet · the one you configured above is the default
providerBook.label: label

apiKeys.heading: outward api keys
apiKeys.intro: Keys a third-party program uses against your public API (smk_…). Different from the MCP keys above: those sign for your own AI client, these are handed to someone else's code. If one leaks, revoke it here.
apiKeys.labelPlaceholder: who is this key for — e.g. 'zapier'
apiKeys.secretOnce: copy it now — the secret is shown only once
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Anything using it stops working immediately.

embed.heading: Embed on another site
embed.blurb: Drop these two lines into any page — your own blog, a client's site, a landing page. No build step and no React: the script registers a <standmeet-chat> element that talks to this instance.
